name: inbox-watch
description: Tell me only when a human actually replied — poll GitHub/IMAP/Resend inbound, classify DMARC vs autoreply vs reply, exit 10 when something real arrived

install_steps: Edit ~/.inbox-watch/config.json (what to watch); secrets go in env vars
install_guidance.note: Single Python 3 file, no dependencies. Config holds what to watch; env vars hold every secret (INBOX_TOKEN / RESEND_API_KEY / ZOHO_IMAP_PASS).

commands.description: Poll every configured channel and print items new since the last run. Exit 10 if any. CONSUMES the cursor — use inbox_peek to diagnose.

adapterConfig.note: --exit-zero because a non-zero exit is treated as failure by the process adapter, and inbox-watch's exit 10 means 'new items' — a success. Read data.count instead.

commands.description: Same report WITHOUT marking items seen. Use this for any diagnostic run: a normal run consumes the alert your cron would have sent.
